blockingFindings.title: RunId coverage can pass without runId resolution
blockingFindings.target: specs/280-flow-get-status-summary/tests/status-details-contract.test.js, test "R4: runId status uses the same default and --details field contract"
blockingFindings.issue: Every successful runId assertion uses a flow that is also registered as the active flow, with the supplied runId equal to the active flow's runId. An implementation that ignores the positional runId and always returns the active flow would satisfy these assertions while violating the runId-based contract.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Make at least one successful runId test resolve a non-active saved flow, or create two flows and assert that requesting the non-active runId returns that specific flow for both default and --details output.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R4 requires the runId form to apply the status contract. The current test has a static anti-pattern that can pass without exercising production runId resolution.

blockingFindings.title: Shared regression coverage is missing from R8
blockingFindings.issue: R8 requires shared regression tests to be updated where production command contracts change, but the coverage artifact lists only the spec-local test file. The R8 test only checks that the spec-local file declares requirement headers and test names; it does not correspond to any shared regression test update.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add or reference an updated shared regression test file that covers the changed production command contract, or narrow the R8 coverage artifact if no shared regression change is actually required by the accepted requirement.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: The requirement coverage artifact marks R8 covered while the actual provided tests do not cover the shared-regression portion of the requirement.
